title: Major Glow Creme & Powder Light Reflecting Translucent Highlighter Duo
descriptionHtml:
✓ Shimmer Finish✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Without Parabens✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Cream Formula
What it is: An intentionally translucent cream-and-powder highlighter duo that lets skin shine through.

Coverage: Light

Finish: Shimmer

Formulation: Cream

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Silica: Gives skin a blurred, soft-focus finish.
- Mango Seed Butter and Shea Butter: Ensure smooth blending and major moisture.
- Squalane: Provides a boost to healthy-looking glow.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, and triclosan. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This talc-free, multidime
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
For a Multidimensional Glow:
-Use Patrick's signature technique by layering cream over powder to melt products together and create a showstopping, multi-faceted luminosity.

For Natural Luminosity:
-Diffuse cream into skin, focusing on high points of the face for a translucent, lit-from-within, dewy radiance.

For High-Impact Shimmer:
-Sweep powder lightly over skin to your desired level of diamond-like, ultra-refined shimmer.
Ingredients+
-Silica: Gives skin a blurred, soft-focus finish.
-Mango Seed Butter and Shea Butter: Ensure smooth blending and major moisture.
-Squalane: Provides a boost to healthy-looking glow.

Creme:
Ethylhexyl Stearate, Isononyl Isononanoate, Polyisobutene, Polyethylene, Ppg-3 Benzyl Ether Myristate, Isostearyl Neopentanoate, Butene/Propylene Copolymer, Nylon-12, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate, Hexadecane, Polycyclopentadiene, Silica, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Squalane, Mangifera Indica (Mango) Seed Butter, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Octyldodecanol, Water, Citric Acid, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77492), Tin Oxide (Ci 77861) , Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Red 30 (Ci 73360), , Aluminum Hydroxide (Ci 77002).

Powder:
Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Boron Nitride, Polysilicone-1 Crosspolymer, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Isostearyl Neopentanoate, , Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Dimethicone, Polycyclopentadiene, Silica, Caprylyl Glycol, Phenoxyethanol, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Water, Rosin, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Tin Oxide (Ci 77861), Red 28 Lake (Ci 45410), Red 6 Lake (Ci 15850), Barium Sulfate (Ci 77120).
